Free warmup — move the test's spam-placed emails back to Inbox on our seed mailboxes (one-off "not spam" signal). Public by test token. Idempotent: a repeat POST returns the cached summary without reconnecting. Does NOT change the report verdict (CheckResult.placement). Ф2: governed by DeliverabilityConfig — a no-op (result.disabled=true) unless an operator has set warmupEnabled=true, and capped by warmupMaxPerRun / warmupMaxPerSeedPerDay / warmupMaxPerDay. Each attempted move is audit-logged; each non-move outcome carries an honest status (not_found / provider_denied / timeout / provider_error / seed_unavailable / limit_reached) + reason instead of a blanket failure.

get.summary:
One-stop visual trace of a single test for debugging logical errors.
Aggregates everything we know about a token end-to-end:
  - test row (full state, decoded fields)
  - per-seed results (placement, auth verdicts, scores, qualityDetails error-blobs)
  - api_usage_events bound to this testId (request/response audit trail)
  - tail of api.out.log + api.err.log filtered by token (PM2 file logs)

Admin-guarded — requires X-Admin-Key. Read-only.

Live end-to-end probe of each public transport endpoint. Hits them on
localhost so we measure server-side latency without nginx + TLS noise.
Used by /artber/health sub-tabs to show a green/red dot per transport.

Aggregated request traffic for the AI-agent transports — MCP (streamable
HTTP bridge at /mcp) and A2A (the .well-known/agent.json handshake +
downstream calls). Lets the admin see at a glance whether real clients
are exercising those endpoints.

Sources:
  - ApiUsageEvent rows (authoritative for authenticated calls; every v1
    controller writes one with req.originProtocol = rest|mcp|a2a).
  - nginx access log (captures anonymous A2A discovery hits that never
    reach the API — GET /.well-known/agent.json has no API key).

info.description: Email deliverability test API for AI agents and automation. Same surface is exposed via REST (here), MCP (streamable-http at /mcp), and A2A (skill manifest at /.well-known/agent.json).

acceptedTosVersion.description:
Versions of the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy the user accepted
at the moment of signup. Required for new registrations going forward
(frontend ships a checkbox + version constants). Optional in this DTO
for one release cycle so the live web frontend keeps working until the
web-MR adds the checkbox; after that we'll tighten to required.

Stored verbatim in `consent_log` row. See W1a.

scopes.description:
Scope ids from `src/api-keys/scopes.ts`. If omitted, the service
chooses a default by source (portal → PRESETS.agent, admin → ['*']).

delay_hours.description: Delay before the same-message recheck. Defaults to 24 hours.
